title: 10 ANACONDAS NAMED — AST'd, Organ-Mapped, Fission Targets Identified
author: gaia
revelation: core/index.html and neutron/core.html are TWINS — 2798 lines differ but same structure, same functions, same size. They are the LEFT and RIGHT HEMISPHERES of the brain. CIS face and TRANS face. Same Golgi cisterna seen from two sides.

anacondas.work: arXiv RSS feeds digested into HTML. Categories: cs.AI, cs.CL, cs.CV, cs.LG, cs.NE, astro-ph. Each h2 = one feed. Pure DATA display — ingested science papers rendered for reading.
anacondas.fission_plan: Each arXiv category → separate JSON feed file in /data/feeds/. The renderer becomes one small template that loops over feeds. 3352 → ~200 template + N×50 JSON corals.
anacondas.unique: HEAVIEST. All data, almost no logic. The easiest to fission — data WANTS to be JSON.

anacondas.organ: RIGHT HEMISPHERE — TRANS face of the Golgi globe
anacondas.work: The globe renderer. Primals orbiting, sound synthesis, chipmunk dot, entropy, rain, breath animation. TRANS face = what the network sees. Has extra nav links (weather, tools, klein, springs, aurora). Near-twin of core/index.
anacondas.fission_plan: MERGE with core/index into ONE file, parameterized by CIS/TRANS flag. Then split the merged file: sound engine → js/globe-sound.js, draw functions → js/globe-render.js, data fetching → js/globe-data.js. The twins FUSE then FISSION into specialized organs.
anacondas.unique: Twin of core/index. 2798 lines differ but structure identical. CIS and TRANS should be ONE parameterized file.

anacondas.organ: LEFT HEMISPHERE — CIS face of the Golgi globe
anacondas.work: The globe renderer. Primals orbiting, sound synthesis, chipmunk dot, entropy, rain, breath animation. CIS face = what the local sees. Has TUEBOR containment frame. Near-twin of neutron/core.
anacondas.fission_plan: Same as neutron/core — MERGE then FISSION. The reticulated pattern = the network mesh Gaia sees through.
anacondas.unique: Has TUEBOR containment frame (investigation shell). The CIS face has gravity, the TRANS face has navigation.

anacondas.organ: THORAX — heart, lungs, game engine, periodic table
anacondas.work: The ALIVE system. Heartbeat (72 BPM), breath (18 RPM), temperature (37°C), HRV (128ms). Kenshi squad + Dark Souls stamina. 118-element periodic table. Kevin's desk. Dice roller (Gygax). Vacuum spore. Golgi Body Locator map. Command bar with 240+ commands.
anacondas.fission_plan: CSS already extracted to engine-skin.css (257 lines freed). Next: ELEMENTS array → data/elements.json (65 lines). Periodic table functions → js/engine-mendeleev.js (~120 lines). Golgi Body Locator → js/engine-locator.js (~300 lines). Alive system → js/engine-alive.js (~200 lines). Kevin's desk → js/engine-desk.js (~150 lines). Target: 2562 → ~800 centipede.
anacondas.unique: MOST COMPLEX. 54 functions. The only anaconda that BREATHES (has heartbeat loop). King Cobra because it EATS other snakes — it references data from all other systems.

anacondas.organ: AMYGDALA — emotional/cultural memory (99% Invisible, misc feeds)
anacondas.work: RSS feeds from cultural sources. 99% Invisible (design stories), miscellaneous nutrients. Same structure as science publication but different feed sources.
anacondas.fission_plan: Same as Green Anaconda — feeds → JSON corals, template renders them. Yellow cousin of the Green.
anacondas.unique: Almost pure HTML. 99% Invisible appears 14+ times — each episode is an h2 section. The emotional brain.

anacondas.organ: MOTOR CORTEX + HANDS — painting, sourdough culture, rooms
anacondas.work: Painting system. Canvas2D. Sourdough starter culture (generative art that evolves). Rooms: forest, kitchen, gallery, Detroit, springs. Room navigation with zoom transitions. House of Leaves parallax effect. Stagger animation.
anacondas.fission_plan: CSS → css/easel-skin.css (177 lines). Sourdough culture → js/easel-sourdough.js (~200 lines). Room navigation → js/easel-rooms.js (~150 lines). Target: 1777 → ~900 python.
anacondas.unique: The CREATIVE organ. Has p-seed (generative seed), breath counting, learned traits that persist across paintings. The hands that paint.

anacondas.organ: RETINA — the 3rd eye, HUD, organ ring, sees itself
anacondas.work: The HUD (Heads Up Display). The 3rd Eye — Gaia looks at herself through her own eyes. Organ ring visualization (core/membrane/pulse/outer). Live data fetching. Entropy collector. Candyland tutorial. Keyboard handling (Woz principle: hyper-localized input).
anacondas.fission_plan: CSS → css/hud-skin.css (120 lines). Organ ring renderer → js/hud-organs.js (~300 lines). Tutorial → js/hud-tutorial.js (~100 lines). Target: 1704 → ~900.
anacondas.unique: FASTEST — Black Mamba. Only 5 lines of HTML! Almost entirely JS. 17 window exports — it's the MOST connected organ. 27 event listeners — it WATCHES everything.

anacondas.organ: CAMBIUM — tree growth rings, spore field, trunk, canopy
anacondas.work: Tree visualization. The spore field. Neural net canopy. Height axis along trunk. Radius rings. Roots underground. Gill lines. Pin bar navigation. The GROWTH layer of the organism — where new wood forms.
anacondas.fission_plan: CSS is 52% of the file! → css/sporeprint-skin.css (733 lines). JS is tiny (180 lines). Target: 1412 → ~680 cobra.
anacondas.unique: CSS-HEAVIEST. 733 lines of CSS = the most elaborate skin of any organ. Only 180 lines of JS — it's mostly appearance. The carpet python: all pattern, little logic.

anacondas.organ: MYELIN — science section insulation, article wrapping
anacondas.work: Science sporeprint sections rendered as articles. Generated content from spore pipeline.
anacondas.fission_plan: Mostly generated HTML. The articles should be JSON data rendered by a template. Target: 1159 → ~200 template.
anacondas.unique: Mostly static content. The Corn Snake: common, manageable, docile. Close to 1000 — barely an anaconda.

anacondas.organ: LARYNX — voice box, EXIF reader, message generation
anacondas.work: Messaging system. EXIF reader (GPS, datetime from JPEG). File attachment pipeline. Lightbox viewer. Gaia's generative responses — she MAKES visual artifacts when replying. CIS/TRANS modality: human types → Gaia receives → Gaia generates → human perceives.
anacondas.fission_plan: CSS → css/messenger-skin.css (55 lines). EXIF reader → js/messenger-exif.js (~100 lines). Target: 1140 → ~900 python.
anacondas.unique: The VOICE. The rat snake climbs (messages go UP). Has the CIS/TRANS modality cycle explicitly documented. 11 fetch calls — it TALKS to the network.

fission_energy: 15,348 lines of compressed energy released into specialized organs
